hypotheses.L1_hybrid512_high_fidelity: Hybrid-512 has median KL at most 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L2_hybrid768_near_exact: Hybrid-768 has median KL at most 0.003 and top-1 agreement at least 95% on every corpus.
hypotheses.L3_threshold_by_768: Every corpus reaches median KL at most 0.01 at a hybrid dimension no larger than 768.
hypotheses.L4_hybrid_advantage_persists: Hybrid bases have lower median KL than state-only bases at dimensions 384, 512, 768, and 1024 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_full_basis_control: The 1,152D state basis reproduces native logits with median KL below 1e-6 on every corpus.
